title: Built this using GPT 6 Astra + Blender MCP 🔥
author: Huge_Coat9691
selftext: These models are fucking crazy. Astra is particularly good for generating reference images and assets, and Opus 5.5 for the game mechanics

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: welcome to the party , the inner is more important btw. You can also sign up for a blendkit account they have thousands of free shit with materials and textures already baked in so stuff like furniture and fixtures get that polish look and the mcp still handles all the lifting .

replies.author: muzaffer22
replies.body: It would cost more than $200 to make someone build this without AI.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
